record.paper: Essentially tight bounds for rainbow cycles in proper edge-colourings

dossier_meta.paper: Essentially tight bounds for rainbow cycles in proper edge-colourings
dossier_meta.statement_text: Given $k\geq 2$, determine the minimum number $t=t(k)$ such that any set of $t$ transpositions in $\mathcal{S}_{k}$ contains a non-empty subset whose elements can be multiplied in some order to give the identity.
dossier_meta.context_text: Appears in Section 10 of the paper, which collects open questions remaining after the main results on rainbow cycles and the connections to additive number theory for non-abelian groups.
